description: Creators only, on their own Piku account (asks them to connect). Send one Draft to its client: a quote goes out with its accept link; an invoice is numbered and goes out with its pay link (or, with send_by self, is marked sent for the creator to send). For use only after the creator has seen this Draft and said yes to sending it. Sending the same Draft again sends nothing.

draft_id.description: The draft_id create_quote or create_invoice returned

name: send_draft
title: Send a Draft
